description: 《魔兽世界》阿尔萨斯／巫妖王非官方同人桌宠：寒冰王冠、幽蓝双眼、冰封板甲与霜之哀伤，含九种独立绘制的动画状态。Unofficial Warcraft fan art of Arthas / the Lich King, with an icy crown, glowing blue eyes, frozen plate armor and Frostmourne. A chibi companion with nine expressive animated states. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders.
